title: raytracer.numberOfThreads = 0 selects the number of logical processors, and is the default
author: Claude-JG
description: The default visualizationSettings.raytracer.numberOfThreads was 8; since the raytracer balances its tiles dynamically (#3439) it scales up to the number of logical processors (0.664 s with 8 against 0.37 s with 32 threads on 16 cores / 32 logical processors). The value 0 selects the number of logical processors (std::thread::hardware_concurrency) and is the new default; a positive value is used as before.
releaseNotes: visualizationSettings.raytracer.numberOfThreads = 0, the new default, uses the number of logical processors of the computer; the raytracer balances its tiles over them.
